newsitem.title: JAMAICA: CRICKET-INJURED SRINATH TO BE SENT HOME.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INJURED SRINATH TO BE SENT HOME.

text.p: Indian bowler Javagal Srinath is to return home from the tour of the West Indies because of a strained right shoulder, coach Madan Lal said on Saturday.
Lal told the Caribbean News Agency (CANA) that Srinath complained of pain in his shoulder in the nets on Thursday, two days after arriving Kingston.
He rejected suggestions that the 27-year-old fast bowler, who along with leg spinner Anil Kumble is considered the team's leading bowler, arrived with the injury.
Lal said a replacement, still to be decided, would be flown out in time for the first test which starts in Kingston on Thursday.
